scientific_integrity: The exact spectrum and asymptotic follow from the displayed Fourier-block Gram calculations, derivative series and exponential expansions; finite numerical checks are supplementary, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion concerns the full harmonic space with cylindrical area measure on a concentric planar annulus, and specifically its logarithmic central cut. Related older annular Toeplitz literature was available only in extracts; historical priority is not guaranteed. No independent audit.
title: A universal one-sixteenth projection defect for harmonic concentration on conformal annuli
